The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is resting in front of it, facing it squarely, with the panel directly ahead.

The corridor was not straight. After about 4 m forward it turned left, and the panel was on the far wall past a block on the left. The robot stopped short of the panel by about 0.3 m. The final approach used a sidestep and a few short moves, and the last step was 0.1 m. Its side sonars read 0.84 m, and it was not bumped.
